name: Cuốn sách của mình
notes: chapters = seconds in film.mp4 where the film waits for a tap, taken from scene.html by stops.py: the closed book (the title frame), the dedication once the cover is open (PAUSE.extra), one stop in each of the six chapters (PAUSE.inBeat into its beat, after the page has turned), the climax (PAUSE.climax: the hollowed last page and the ring, just before it lifts), and the last frame (the veil over the book). Each sits a quarter of a frame into its frame, so a seek shows that frame and the player finds its boxes. hints = the scene's own words at those stops (WORDS.cue, ui.next, WORDS.hint, ui.skip); a card can override them with "chapters". reveal = null: no 3D envelope; after the last stop a tap opens the letter. slots.json: cover-t and cover-by are the gold title and byline on the cover; plate-who her name on the bookplate; tp-t, tp-by and tp-ded the title, byline and dedication on the title page; ch0-t, ch0-x ... ch5-x the title and text of each chapter; fin-top and fin-bot the lines above and below the ring; ask the question when the ring lifts. photos = 6: slots.json "photos" makes the six drawings on the left-hand pages photo places, in the order the pages show them (0 coffee, 1 rain, 2 motorbike, 3 beach, 4 home, 5 cat: the scene's stand-in drawings; on screen in frames 64-97, 97-130, 129-162, 162-194, 194-227 and 226-261). Each play the player shuffles the card's photos and lays photo k over drawing k in every frame: as its leaf turns over, while its page lies open, and as the next leaf comes down over it; a drawing with no photo shows as before. A place is the drawing's whole 200 x 140 box (355.5 x 248.8 film pixels on the open page; the caption "HÌNH n" under it stays), measured in render.html at each moment render.py drew: a flat box while its page lies open, its four corners while its leaf turns (the photo turns with the page, in perspective), and its corners clipped to what the next leaf has not covered yet. aspect = 1.4286 (200 / 140): the photo is cropped to the picture's own shape, so a turning page squeezes it with the page instead of cropping it narrower. overlay: the light the scene lays over a drawing goes over its photo too, in the picture's own space: while its leaf turns, the page's shade (.back .shade, a gradient across the page from the spine, at opacity sin(angle)), and as the next leaf comes down, that leaf's shadow (.cast.l). Over the picture the page fraction from the spine is .91 - .79u, so both run from u = 1.152 (the spine) to u = -0.114 (the outer edge) with the scene's own stops, plus stops in between where the shade changes colour (CSS mixes gradient stops premultiplied, a canvas does not). Compromises: the pages turn in 3D but the card's words are painted flat over the film, so a page's words fade out as its leaf lifts and fade in once the turning leaf has passed (alpha, the 5th number of each box); the faint dust drifting over a drawing goes under its photo; the cover title is flat gold, not gold foil; the chapter text has no drop cap; the picture captions show only "HÌNH n" (the chapter title is on the facing page); "Một cuốn sách nhỏ", "Sách này của", "Chương cuối" and "Chưa vẽ" (the empty picture facing the last page, not a photo place) are printed in the film. The book title and byline appear twice (the cover and the title page), so a card gives them twice. fonts = the faces the player paints these slots in.
